articles.title: U.S. CFTC rebuffs CME legal stance in consequential fight over perpetual futures
articles.snippet: The future of perps in the U.S. may be at stake as the CFTC argues that CME hasn't shown the new policy is hurting it after the agency OK'd its first bitcoin perp.

articles.title: Bitcoin whale moves $34 million in BTC it got in 2013 when coins traded at $131
articles.snippet: A bitcoin wallet dormant since 2013 moved 411 BTC, now worth about $34 million. It is one of several long-dormant wallets to wake up recently.

articles.title: Wall Street freaked out Friday, but VIX and bitcoin trades say the fear may fade Monday.
articles.snippet: Wall Street's fear gauge, the VIX index, spiked on Friday as stocks dropped. History says Friday panics usually fade on Monday. Seasonality and calm bitcoin markets suggest the same.

articles.title: Solana treasury firm SkyAI sells all SOL holdings, launches $201M buyback
articles.snippet: The former medical device maker has liquidated its Solana treasury and is offering to repurchase shares and warrants using its $223.8 million cash holdings.

articles.title: Crypto PAC pours $362K into California race voters essentially decided in August
articles.snippet: A Fairshake affiliate is supporting incumbent Aisha Wahab through ads in November, but the congresswoman already won a special election in the district.
